metadata.description: In the first phase of Lok Sabha elections in Jharkhand, held on May 13, voter turnout reached 63.14% by 5 p.m. Polling started at 7 a.m. across four constituencies: Singhbhum, Lohardaga, Khunti, and Palamu, with tight security measures in place. Notably, three out of these four seats are reserved for Scheduled Tribes. Officials reported peaceful polling in all constituencies. Amidst this, the Main Bhi Bharat team is actively engaging with voters to gauge the prevailing sentiments. One of their stops was the Sunday Market in Namkum, Ranchi, which attracts both urban and rural residents. This ground report aims to provide insights into the electoral mood and sentiments of the populace in Jharkhand.
